## Checklist

- [ ] Plugin has a `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` manifest
- [ ] Plugin has at least one command or skill
- [ ] Plugin has been tested in a fresh Claude Code session
- [ ] Plugin uses an MIT-compatible license
- [ ] Description is clear and concise
